citation: Herman, Melançon & Marshall (2000), Graph Visualization and Navigation in Information Visualization: A Survey, IEEE TVCG 6(1), https://doi.org/10.1109/2945.841119
method_or_claim: Surveys graph drawing and navigation techniques and their task trade-offs.
relevance_to_TRACE: Supports separating graph structure from navigation and display.
visual_risk: A layout algorithm can look semantically authoritative.
composition_implication: Topology and layout require separate contracts.

citation: Purchase (1997), Which Aesthetic Has the Greatest Effect on Human Understanding?, Graph Drawing, https://doi.org/10.1007/3-540-63938-1_67
method_or_claim: Empirically compares common graph aesthetics for comprehension.
relevance_to_TRACE: Supports testing legibility rather than assuming it.
visual_risk: Readability optimization can be mistaken for evidentiary optimization.
composition_implication: Keep visual aesthetics presentation-only.

citation: Ware, Purchase, Colpoys & McGill (2002), Cognitive Measurements of Graph Aesthetics, Information Visualization 1(2), https://doi.org/10.1057/palgrave.ivs.9500013
method_or_claim: Measures cognitive effects of graph aesthetics on path tasks.
relevance_to_TRACE: Shows that geometry changes what viewers can infer.
visual_risk: Shortest-looking paths may acquire unintended salience.
composition_implication: Audit path, crossing, and distance implications.
limitations: Task findings do not establish historical meaning.

citation: Ghoniem, Fekete & Castagliola (2005), On the Readability of Graphs Using Node-Link and Matrix-Based Representations, Information Visualization 4, https://doi.org/10.1057/palgrave.ivs.9500092
method_or_claim: Controlled comparison of node-link and matrix readability at different densities.
relevance_to_TRACE: Supports strict density bounds and alternate representations later.
visual_risk: Dense node-link views obscure structure and invite gestalt over-reading.
composition_implication: Bound degree and decompose large inputs.

citation: Holten (2006), Hierarchical Edge Bundles, IEEE TVCG 12(5), https://doi.org/10.1109/TVCG.2006.147
method_or_claim: Bundles edges using a hierarchy to reduce clutter.
relevance_to_TRACE: Demonstrates that clutter reduction embeds structural assumptions.
visual_risk: Bundling can imply group membership and hierarchy.
composition_implication: Do not bundle Round 15 associations.
limitations: Technique paper, not an epistemic study.

citation: Beck, Burch, Diehl & Weiskopf (2017), A Taxonomy and Survey of Dynamic Graph Visualization, Computer Graphics Forum 36(1), https://doi.org/10.1111/cgf.12791
method_or_claim: Taxonomizes time representation and mental-map trade-offs.
relevance_to_TRACE: Supports treating temporal/dynamic layout as a separate future concern.
visual_risk: Animation may imply historical succession.
composition_implication: No temporal animation or arrow semantics in V1.
limitations: Dynamic graphs are outside the current static contract.

citation: Furnas & Bederson (1995), Space-Scale Diagrams: Understanding Multiscale Interfaces, CHI, https://doi.org/10.1145/223904.223934
method_or_claim: Formalizes multiscale interface behavior and zoom navigation.
relevance_to_TRACE: Supports future presentation-only semantic zoom.
visual_risk: Zoom levels can appear to encode importance.
composition_implication: Zoom may alter detail, never association eligibility.

citation: Heer & Shneiderman (2012), Interactive Dynamics for Visual Analysis, Communications of the ACM 55(4), https://doi.org/10.1145/2133806.2133821
method_or_claim: Organizes interactive operations for exploration and analysis.
relevance_to_TRACE: Supports filtering, selection, history, and annotation as explicit operations.
visual_risk: Hidden interaction state can make outputs irreproducible.
composition_implication: Persist filters and keep semantic output independent of view state.

citation: Brehmer & Munzner (2013), A Multi-Level Typology of Abstract Visualization Tasks, IEEE TVCG 19(12), https://doi.org/10.1109/TVCG.2013.124
method_or_claim: Separates why, how, and what in visualization tasks.
relevance_to_TRACE: Supports separating inquiry intent, data, and encoding.
visual_risk: One overloaded field can conflate task and evidence.
composition_implication: Keep semantic, composition, topology, and presentation roles separate.

citation: Munzner (2009), A Nested Model for Visualization Design and Validation, IEEE TVCG 15(6), https://doi.org/10.1109/TVCG.2009.111
method_or_claim: Separates domain problem, abstraction, encoding/interaction, and algorithm validation.
relevance_to_TRACE: Directly supports layered validation and distinct failure modes.
visual_risk: An encoding fix can accidentally mutate domain semantics.
composition_implication: Validate semantic and presentation layers independently.
limitations: Requires domain review that Round 15 has not completed.

citation: MacEachren et al. (2005), Visualizing Geospatial Information Uncertainty: What We Know and What We Need to Know, Cartography and Geographic Information Science 32(3), https://doi.org/10.1559/1523040054738936
method_or_claim: Synthesizes uncertainty sources, representations, and research gaps.
relevance_to_TRACE: Supports explicit uncertainty provenance and task-aware encoding.
visual_risk: Uncertainty marks may be misread as low value or error.
composition_implication: Represent gap/status with text and provenance, not rank.

citation: Kinkeldey, MacEachren & Schiewe (2014), How to Assess Visual Communication of Uncertainty?, The Cartographic Journal 51(4), https://doi.org/10.1179/1743277414Y.0000000099
method_or_claim: Systematic review emphasizes task-centered evaluation.
relevance_to_TRACE: Supports fixture-specific leakage questions.
visual_risk: A generic uncertainty glyph may fail the actual review task.
composition_implication: Audit causality, hierarchy, importance, split, prune, and gap readings separately.
limitations: Geospatial user studies dominate the sample.

citation: Kinkeldey, MacEachren, Riveiro & Schiewe (2017), Evaluating the Effect of Visually Represented Geodata Uncertainty on Decision-Making, Cartography and Geographic Information Science 44(1), https://doi.org/10.1080/15230406.2015.1089792
method_or_claim: Reviews effects of uncertainty displays on reasoning and decisions.
relevance_to_TRACE: Supports cautious, review-oriented rather than decorative uncertainty encoding.
visual_risk: Visibility can change trust without improving understanding.
composition_implication: Record interpretation risk for every tested encoding.
limitations: Decision tasks differ from archival exploration.

citation: Panagiotidou et al. (2022/2023), Communicating Uncertainty in Digital Humanities Visualization Research, IEEE TVCG 29(1), https://doi.org/10.1109/TVCG.2022.3209436
method_or_claim: Reviews 126 DH visualization publications and identifies uncertainty across the research process.
relevance_to_TRACE: Directly supports retaining evidence gaps and qualitative uncertainty.
visual_risk: Over-objective displays conceal source and datafication uncertainty.
composition_implication: Make gap, provenance, and qualification first-class fields.
limitations: Review reports field practice, not one universal encoding.

citation: Panagiotidou & Vande Moere (2022), Communicating Qualitative Uncertainty in Data Visualization, Information Design Journal 27(1), https://doi.org/10.1075/idj.22014.pan
method_or_claim: Uses DH cases to argue for socio-technical, participatory, process-aware uncertainty design.
relevance_to_TRACE: Supports human-review packets and explicit source/process context.
visual_risk: Numeric confidence can erase indirect qualitative uncertainty.
composition_implication: Do not collapse qualification into a scalar.

citation: Scheidegger et al. (2008), Tackling the Provenance Challenge One Layer at a Time, Concurrency and Computation 20(5), https://doi.org/10.1002/cpe.1237
method_or_claim: Demonstrates layered, change-based provenance for exploratory visualization workflows.
relevance_to_TRACE: Supports traceable semantic and presentation transformations.
visual_risk: Unrecorded workflow changes make a visual claim unauditable.
composition_implication: Bind each admitted edge to assessment, evidence, and source.

citation: Freire et al. (2008), Provenance for Computational Tasks: A Survey, Computing in Science & Engineering 10(3), https://doi.org/10.1109/MCSE.2008.79
method_or_claim: Surveys provenance capture and use in computational exploration.
relevance_to_TRACE: Supports reproducibility, attribution, and audit queries.
visual_risk: Provenance omitted from the view can conceal construction choices.
composition_implication: Preserve machine-resolvable provenance in every image.

citation: Drucker (2011), Humanities Approaches to Graphical Display, Digital Humanities Quarterly 5(1), https://www.digitalhumanities.org/dhqdev/vol/5/1/000091/000091.html
method_or_claim: Argues that humanistic visualization must express interpretation, ambiguity, and constructed data.
relevance_to_TRACE: Foundational support for the semantic/presentation boundary and non-claims.
visual_risk: Realist graphics can present interpretation as fact.
composition_implication: Expose uncertainty and the constructed status of composition.
limitations: Programmatic argument rather than user study.

citation: Ahnert, Ahnert, Coleman & Weingart (2020), The Network Turn: Changing Perspectives in the Humanities, https://doi.org/10.1017/9781108866804
method_or_claim: Treats networks as metaphors with cultural and epistemological histories.
relevance_to_TRACE: Supports refusing a network diagram as a literal historical ontology.
visual_risk: Network form can naturalize connectivity and power assumptions.
composition_implication: Call Round 15 output composition, not relation knowledge.

citation: Lamqaddam et al. (2021), Introducing Layers of Meaning, IEEE TVCG 27(2), https://doi.org/10.1109/TVCG.2020.3030426
method_or_claim: Co-design framework grounds visualization in time, space, physicality, terminology, nuance, and provenance.
relevance_to_TRACE: Supports layered annotations and provenance-rich review.
visual_risk: Semantically distant generic graphics feel reductive.
composition_implication: Keep qualification and source terminology adjacent to the image.

citation: Lamqaddam, De Prekel, Brosens & Verbert (2022), Perceptual Effects of Hierarchy in Art Historical Social Networks, DHQ 16(1), https://www.digitalhumanities.org/dhq/vol/16/1/000604/000604.html
method_or_claim: User study shows that hierarchical and force-directed layouts change perception and insight.
relevance_to_TRACE: Direct evidence that layout is interpretive in historical networks.
visual_risk: Vertical or tree layouts can imply social or historical hierarchy.
composition_implication: Use one peer layer by default and audit topology readings.
limitations: Fifteen participants and a specific art-historical setting.

citation: Windhager et al. (2019), Visualization of Cultural Heritage Collection Data: State of the Art and Future Challenges, IEEE TVCG 25(6), https://doi.org/10.1109/TVCG.2018.2830759
method_or_claim: Surveys visualization systems for digital cultural collections and humanistic challenges.
relevance_to_TRACE: Supports generous exploration, criticality, and collection-aware design.
visual_risk: Visual overview may flatten heterogeneous collection contexts.
composition_implication: Keep collection/context signals presentation-only pending research.

citation: Whitelaw (2015), Generous Interfaces for Digital Cultural Collections, Digital Humanities Quarterly 9(1), https://openresearch-repository.anu.edu.au/items/48c21566-712d-481a-af25-52f868a93aad
method_or_claim: Argues for browsable interfaces that reveal scale, richness, and context beyond search.
relevance_to_TRACE: Supports future exploratory access without requiring relation inference.
visual_risk: Generosity can look like comprehensive historical coverage.
composition_implication: Pair overview with scope and evidence-gap disclosure.

citation: Conroy (2021), Networks, Maps, and Time: Visualizing Historical Networks Using Palladio, DHQ 15(1), https://digitalhumanities.org/dhq/vol/15/1/000534/000534.html
method_or_claim: Critiques how tool and middleware assumptions disappear in exported historical visualizations.
relevance_to_TRACE: Supports method/version and presentation-hash disclosure.
visual_risk: Similar-looking outputs can conceal different assumptions.
composition_implication: Serialize the method and audit trail with every image.

citation: Dörk, Carpendale & Williamson (2011), The Information Flaneur, CHI, https://doi.org/10.1145/1978942.1979124
method_or_claim: Reframes information seeking around orientation, diversity, and playful exploration.
relevance_to_TRACE: Supports diversity as an interface goal after evidence qualification.
visual_risk: Serendipitous layout can be mistaken for semantic similarity.
composition_implication: Diversity may arrange supported candidates but cannot create eligibility.
limitations: Exploratory behavior study, not historical validation.
